exposure: maternal obesity (BMI of 30 kg/m2 or more)
cohort: 300 pregnant patients from a tertiary care hospital in Kolkata were included in this study.
finding: Maternal obesity significantly increases the risk of adverse fetomaternal outcomes including gestational diabetes, hypertension, preeclampsia, preterm birth, macrosomia, shoulder dystocia, and neonatal intensive care admissions.
gest_age: preterm birth was an outcome measured
